dedupeResult: The complete active pull-request repository search was checked separately for CJSR, CFUV and KXCI before creation and returned no existing route records. Canonical domains, normalized station names, submission paths, Music Department contacts, accepted formats and digital-versus-physical delivery modes were compared. Each station is represented once even where it offers both digital and physical delivery.
emailVerificationLevel: CJSR's music@cjsr.com and CFUV's music@cfuv.ca were confirmed as plaintext, first-party, purpose-specific and domain-matched music-submission addresses published by the stations. KXCI presents its Music Department address through a protected first-party email link; it was not decoded, guessed or stored. No SMTP, MX, catch-all or mailbox-level deliverability probe was performed.
safety: No email, message, form or submission was sent; no track, album, EP, audio file, download code, MP3 or WAV link, biography, artwork, timed track list, metadata, physical media, rights declaration or consent was supplied; no protected email address was decoded; no CAPTCHA, anti-bot, human-verification, cookie, login or platform control was handled or bypassed; no advertising, payment or postage workflow was started; no contact was guessed; and no SMTP/MX/deliverability probing was performed.
